chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Muhammad ibn Ismail — similar to it.

Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Zakariyya Abu Yahya, who said: I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) asking him about the fermented drink (al-fuqqa'), and I described it to him. So he said: 'Do not drink it.' So I repeated to him all of that, describing it to him as to how it is made. So he said: 'Do not drink it, and do not come back to me regarding it.'

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan, referring to the Imam (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْفُقَّاع: A specific type of fermented drink mentioned in Shia jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on drinking al-fuqqa according to Imam Al-Hassan (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the rigorous scrutiny of specific fermented beverages (*khamr*) in Shia jurisprudence, where Imam Al-Hassan al-Rida (peace be upon him) maintained a strict prohibition (*la tashrabhu*) despite the narrator's repeated attempts to clarify the preparation method. The Imam's final command, 'do not revisit me regarding it,' underscores the definitive nature of this ruling, distinguishing it from cases where preparation details might alter the legal status. This reflects the broader Shia scholarly emphasis on the intoxicating potential and impurity of such drinks, regardless of minor variations in their production.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Muhammad Bin Ismail – similar to it.

Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Zakariyya Abu Yahya who said, 
‘I wrote to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the fermented drink, and I described it to him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not drink it’. So I re-iterated to him<sup>asws</sup>, during all of that I described it to him<sup>asws</sup> how it is made. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Neither drink it nor come back to me<sup>asws</sup> with regards to it’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Bakr ibn Salih from Zakariya abu Yahya who has said the following: “I once wrote to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, asked about al-Fuqa ’ and described it for him (the Imam) how it is made. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not drink it and do not come back to me about it again.’”
